text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While conducting a dance lesson with<n>Mejiro
Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sorry, can you stop the music?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you even have to ask? I'm not<n>doing it right at
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but I can't seem<n>to dance the
way I want to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to repay all the fans supporting<n>me, but
there's no way I can do that<n>with this lackluster
dance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to repay all the fans supporting<n>me, but
there's no way I can do that<n>with this lackluster
dance...
Don't sell yourself short!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wha? P-Pearl?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fear not! I'm here to blow away<n>those itty-bitty
worries of yours!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, let's get dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait... You mean, you're going to<n>dance too?! I-I...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course I am! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-um... Your dancing is so bold and<n>gorgeous, and
dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But those are all qualities I lack...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I can't ever seem to get things right<n>when I dance...
It doesn't feel like I<n>can convey anything with my
dancing.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That may be true... but it may also not<n>be true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Our performances ride the airwaves<n>from living
rooms here in Japan, to<n>the other side of the world...
and all<n>the way to outer space!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: With so many people watching us,there's no way none of them feelanything from our concerts.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just like how you said my dancing is<n>perfect,
someone out there might be<n>saying the same thing
about yours.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The possibilities are endless! You<n>have to be more
optimistic!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More optimistic? ...You think even mydancing could be perfect to someoneout there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay, Pearl. I'll keep trying.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because she finally<n>starts believing in
her own potential,<n>but Mejiro Dober's dancing
becomes sharper than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I really appreciate your help today. I<n>don't know
how to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to do that. Though, if<n>you want to
thank someone, thank<n>the people you want to
express your<n>feelings to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But... there are so many of them.
choice_data_list: Then start with the people around you.
You could stream yourself to the world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The people around me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
J-just so you know, that category<n>doesn't include
you at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then I guess I have to start with the<n>person closest
to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep practicing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep practicing!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober continues with her<n>dance lesson,
and...

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Dober's dancing! She looks so<n>dignified and
powerful... and sooo<n>cool!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She polishes her dancing into<n>something that can
convey her<n>feelings to others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You mean... I should make my<n>dancing famous
around the world?

text_block_list.name: International Fans
text_block_list.text: Ahhhh! Dober! Look over here!<n>Dance for us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A-as if! There's no way I can do that!
choice_data_list: You'll just have to practice more, then.
You'll just have to practice more, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's far too embarrassing.<n>There's no way I
can do that...
choice_data_list: You'll just have to practice more, then.
You'll just have to practice more, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean! I'm talking<n>about the
mental hurdle here!
choice_data_list:
Okay, then we'll just have to strengthen you
mentally too!

Okay, then we'll just have to strengthen you
mentally too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm glad you're so confident in<n>my skills, but
the mental hurdle is<n>more of the problem here...
choice_data_list:
Okay, then we'll just have to strengthen you
mentally too!

Okay, then we'll just have to strengthen you
mentally too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... How do I get through to you?<n>What I'm trying
to say is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's not what I... Wait... Maybe it<n>is?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Losing to my persistence, Mejiro<n>Dober continues
with her lesson and<n>improves the precision of her
dancing.

text_block_list.text:
Losing to my persistence, Mejiro<n>Dober continues
with her lesson and<n>improves the precision of her
dancing.
